title: Noto Sans JP
description: The standard Japanese gothic published by Google Fonts. Weights run from Thin to Black, and both readability and glyph coverage are high. A general default from captions to subtitles to UI. The binary (one variable font, weight 100 to 900) is already bundled at assets/font/noto-sans-jp/NotoSansJP-Variable.ttf in this repo (noted 2026-07-23. The catalog side stays an index, and source below is the fetch record).
when_to_use: Scenes that want a Japanese caption, subtitle, or UI line that simply stays readable, with no particular look. A standard face for a wide range of tones, including a company intro or an explainer
ai_usage: 取得後はウェイト（Regular/Medium/Bold 等）を用途に応じて選び分けてよい（見出しは Bold〜Black、本文字幕は Regular〜Medium）。字間・行間・カラーは overlay 側の CSS で調整してよいが、グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない。複数ウェイトを同一テロップ内で混在させる場合も、系列を Noto Sans JP のまま保つ

provenance.origin: AKARI Video 素材カタログ収録（Google Fonts / Noto Project, Adobe 系譜）/ 2026-07-14
